description: St. Paul, MN – Today, House DFL Leader Melissa Hortman announced a bipartisan power-sharing agreement that allowed the Minnesota House to begin conducting business during today’s session. Rep. Cheryl Youakim (DFL-Hopkins) released the following statement: “This common-sense power sharing agreement is what Democrats and Minnesotans have been asking for all along.
